# 1.2.108 - The Class Trial console rebuilt: one large window with the status on top, the trial's read-out on the left, the chapter's case schema on the right and the GM's bar at the bottom; the schema ticked node by node while the trial runs, with hints after presentations and a summary of only what was found for the players after the verdict; and three new trial modes played by standing in the hall's two zones - Straw Poll, Logic Dive and Scrum Debate - with the trial's Findings

Stages E73 and E99 (`with` E73), one release: they were ready first, and the owner agreed on 12.11.2026 ("Zgoda") to ship
them as 1.2.108; the curtain train (E61 and E62) becomes 1.2.109, and E92 (the Spectator), built on that train's line,
ships with it. Its range is v1.2.107 (235c3210) to the release commit:
at b3df4284, forty-eight commits, eight of them merges - sixteen on the E73 line (6002ca84 to 6a914d02), twenty-two on
the E99 line (9290ce03 to 9ca7fcc1; the last four are round 6: aa4a8f69 the size fix, 61d9d9cd the summary once a
trial with its sound and its world-secrets rule, a3e77af7 R190's fixture, 9ca7fcc1 its STATUS), two on the gaps-65 line
(8ec660aa the season reset's fix, b8b5699f its STATUS), and the merges e94630ae (the 1.2.107 line into E73), 70b345bf
(the E97 fix into E99), ce6a4764 (the 1.2.107 line into E99), fd3c07df (E73 into E99), c8fb5ca5 (E99 onto 1.2.107),
f04d823c (the text trim), aeb63403 (round 6) and b3df4284 (the gaps-65 line). The release commit comes on top. In
plain words:

- **The Class Trial window is one large window.** **The case > Class Trial** now opens 1280 pixels wide (less on a
  narrower screen) and as tall as the screen. With no trial running, the console's lines stand at the top and the
  chapter's case schema - the Map you built in the Investigation panel - fills the rest, read only. While a trial runs:
  the status and a **mode picker** at the top (one button for each mode, greyed with the reason while an Objection, a
  round or a zone mode holds the floor), the trial's read-out on the left (the mode, Trial evidence log, Findings,
  Missing Key Remnants, the vote; it scrolls by itself), the case schema on the right, and the GM's bar and the footer
  pinned at the bottom. The mode starts left the footer for the picker.
- **The case schema at the trial.** Every node is shown whole, as on the Map; drag to move it, scroll to zoom, or use
  **-**, **+** and **Fit to view** in the strip under it. While a trial runs, each deduction, counter and solution has a
  tick button on its tile: press it when the class gets there (any GM can tick). A node with a trial mode carries that
  mode's start under its tick. Remnants a student has presented are marked **Presented**, and a deduction gets a
  **hint** when students other than the culprit have presented more than half of what it rests on - a hint is never a
  tick. Before a trial the schema shows nothing to tick.
- **Show summary.** After the verdict, **Show summary** (Pokaż podsumowanie) shows the GM exactly what the players will
  get: the Remnants on the schema that someone found, the ticked deductions and counters, and the solution only if the
  class voted right. **Send to everyone** (Wyślij wszystkim) posts it as one public chat card, once a trial; **Close**,
  the default, sends nothing. Greyed before the verdict and in a Final Trial.
- **Zone A and Zone B.** Room Setup's **Scenes** tab picks two regions of the trial hall as **Zone A** and **Zone B**
  (Strefa A, Strefa B), and warns when they are missing, the same region, overlapping or leave part of the hall
  uncovered. Outside the three zone modes the zones do nothing.
- **Straw Poll, Logic Dive, Scrum Debate.** Three new modes, started from the mode picker: players answer by where their
  token stands. **Straw Poll** - 45 seconds, one count, two thirds on one side is a Finding, else the class is split and
  Scrum Debate is the next step. **Logic Dive** - sets of 1 to 5 questions you write ahead; a majority goes on, and a
  wrong answer or a tie ends the set without showing the right answer. **Scrum Debate** - the two camps speak in turn,
  the smaller first, and anyone may cross. When a mode ends, every token goes back to its stand.
- **Findings.** What the class settles in a zone mode is a Finding; the console's **Findings (n)** lists them, and the GM
  can add, edit, delete and mark **Monokuma confirms** - each press is a public card. The list stands on the vote's
  opening card.
- **A season reset gives each passage back.** After a reset, a player could be left with no passage they should have
  had, until something else touched their character. Now they get theirs back (below).

Nothing in this version ran at a real table or on a Foundry server; what was measured was measured headless or in
Chromium through the module's style harness (the module's stylesheets, not Foundry's, and not Foundry's window header).
Below, an R number names one of the module's own tests (`game.drpg.runTests()`), and a scenario one of the headless
harness's multi-browser runs. The gaps are in Not in this release, Known gaps and Checked.

## Before installing

- **The Class Trial window is larger and laid out anew** (E73, 5fc377d4, c6e723df, ce058521; the owner's mockup B). It
  opens 1280 px wide, held to the screen less 8 px a side, as tall as the screen and 8 px from its top, with and without
  a trial. With no trial: the console's lines, the read-only case schema, and the footer's **Close**, **Start the Final
  Trial** and **Start the Class Trial** under it. While a trial runs: the status (the first line, the trial's time, the
  table's scene, the register) and the mode picker at the top; the read-out on the left with its own scroll; the case
  schema on the right; the GM's bar and the footer at the bottom. Under 44rem of body the two columns stack and the
  window scrolls. Measured only in Chromium through the style harness (Checked); in Foundry, LIVE-E73-05.
- **The mode starts moved.** **Nonstop Debate**, **Testimony**, **Panic Round**, **Closing Argument**, **Straw Poll**,
  **Logic Dive** and **Scrum Debate** are the picker's buttons, each greyed with its reason on hover: Nonstop Debate
  while any mode holds the floor, the others while an Objection, a round or a zone mode holds it (a running Nonstop
  Debate greys none of them), and the zone modes also while the hall has no zones. The footer keeps no mode start,
  but for a default **Scrum Debate** after a split Straw Poll.
- **Room Setup's Scenes tab** has two new selects, **Zone A** and **Zone B**, listing the hall's regions that are not
  rooms. The tab, the Scenes report and the Pre-season check warn: no zones; only one, or a zone's region gone; both the
  same region; overlapping; part of the hall uncovered; a hall with no grid whose coverage could not be checked in
  time. The Pre-season check's hall row now counts any of these zone warnings, "no zones" among them, as not done (the
  row is done only when the Scenes report is empty; a default, owner to confirm).
- **No world migration.** Nothing is renamed or rewritten at load. `sceneRoles` gains `zones: { a, b }` beside `school`
  and `trial`; a hall with none behaves as before.
- **New stored data**:
  - two GM stores, both synced between GMs and written by any GM (an Assistant too): **Logic Dive's sets** (`diveSets`
    under the client setting `gmDiveSets`: each set's questions, answers and which answer is right; in the case backup,
    cut with the Key Remnant plan's group), and **the case's ticks** (`caseTicks` under `gmCaseTicks`: a row per chapter
    and node: ticked or not, who and when; not backed up, cut with the trial's group);
  - in the trial's record (`trialProgress`), `findings`, `strawPoll` and `summaryShown` (when the summary was sent, a
    time; cleared when a trial starts), the trial's own;
  - on the floor, a zone mode's question and its two answers, never which one is right (world-secrets.mjs keeps `truth`
    out of `trialQueue`);
  - the summary's chat card, public, speaker "Case summary" (Podsumowanie sprawy), flags `caseSummary` (the payload and
    nothing else) and `sfx` (its sound); no other flag and no speaker actor or token (world-secrets.mjs).
- **Two new player requests**, each answered on the primary GM: **trial.side** (a participant with no token in the hall
  picks Zone A or Zone B), refused with a reason when no zone mode holds the floor, when the character takes no part,
  when it stands in the hall (its token answers) or when it has already picked that same side; and **trial.keyword** (a
  Scrum Debate speaker's thesis), refused when no Scrum Debate holds the floor or when it is not that character's turn.
- **The GM request trial.gm** (an Assistant GM's press carried to the primary) gains five operations - `straw`, `dive`,
  `scrum`, `zoneCount` and `zoneSkipQuestion` - and five fields - `a`, `b`, `thesis`, `set` and `from` (bridge-table.mjs).
- **Sound**: five new rows in the Sound panel - Straw Poll result, Logic Dive: right answer, Logic Dive: wrong answer,
  Zone entered (with no file of its own it plays Room entered) and The case summary (played with the summary card). The
  zone modes play the debate's music.
- **`game.drpg`** gains `startStrawPoll`, `startLogicDive`, `startScrumDebate`, `countNow`, `skipQuestion`, `zoneSides`,
  `openZonePicker`, `openDiveSets`, `editDiveSet`, `findings`, `addFinding`, `editFinding`, `deleteFinding`,
  `confirmFinding` and `openFindings` (tools/api-surface.json).
- **What players can now see**: in a zone mode, the question, each zone's answer, where they stand, the count, the
  Straw Poll's result, a Logic Dive question's verdict (never the right answer after a wrong one or a tie), a Scrum
  speaker's thesis, and the Findings' cards; a player with no token in the hall gets a window to pick a side; their
  token is put back on its stand when the mode ends. After the GM sends it, the summary card. Nothing of the case
  schema, its ticks or its hints: the schema is drawn in the GM's console only, and the ticks are a GM store (read in
  the code; R3672, R3913). The player handbook's section 12 has a new part, "The hall's zones".
- **`module.json`**: unchanged but for the version. No `verified` is raised without a check at a real table.

## The trial hall's zones (E73 C0, C1, 6002ca84)

- zone-geometry.mjs (new, imports nothing of the module's windows): the hall's two zones from `sceneRoles.zones`; which
  zone a point and a token stand in - the region's own `tokens` first, then v14's `testPoint` with the token's elevation,
  then the region's polygon or box; a centre both zones hold is on neither side; whether the zones cover the hall (its
  grid squares, or for a gridless hall a 50 px lattice within 200 ms, Q-E73-4); the warnings. rooms.mjs `isZoneRegion`:
  a zone is no room and no undecided region. Red first: R3900, R3901, R3902 and tier 2 "E73 C1" at 4077664 ("no
  zone-geometry.mjs, no scenesZoneRows, no isZoneRegion"); green at 6002ca84. R2018 follows the filled row.

## Straw Poll, Logic Dive and Scrum Debate (E73 C2-C5, 5101742c)

- trial-zones.mjs (new): `sidesNow` on every client (one student per connected player, no Monocub, no muted dead), the
  stands kept on the floor and given back in one write when a zone mode ends by any road, the starts, and the two
  requests. trial-zones-ui.mjs (new): the console's panel for a zone mode, the **Hall zones** window (Strefy sali) the
  picker's three buttons open, the side-pick window, the zones drawn on the hall during a zone mode and the entry's
  sound. zone-machine.mjs (new, pure): the three modes' phases.
- **Straw Poll**: 45 s, then one count (the clock or **Count now**, Policz teraz); a Finding when `3 x larger >= 2 x
  counted`, else a split whose next step is Scrum Debate. **Logic Dive**: 60 s a question, closed early once everybody
  stands on one side after 10 s or on Count now, a 5 s pause with the count shown, then a simple majority; a wrong
  answer or a tie (0:0 too) ends the set and shows no truth; **Skip question** (Pomiń pytanie) keeps no answer; **End
  this mode** keeps the question it stopped at; a set can be replayed, and the window tells the GM where it ended.
  **Scrum Debate**: 45 s for the camps to form, then twice the larger camp's turns of 300 s divided by the turns, held
  between 20 and 40 s, the smaller camp first, speakers in rotation from the camp as it stands; a camp that empties ends
  it with the other camp's answer as a Finding.
- The modes are rows of floor-machine.mjs `MODES` and trial-floor.mjs `MODE_RULES` (family "zones": everyone speaks
  and presents in Straw Poll and Logic Dive, only the speaker in Scrum Debate, no Objection in any), with
  `MODE_STARTS` "zones". Red first: R3903-R3908 and tier 2 "E73 C3, C4" at 4077664 (no trial-zones.mjs, no
  zone-machine.mjs); green at 5101742c: R3906 (6 people 4:2 and 7 people 5:2 a Finding, 4:3 and 3:3 a split), R3907
  (5:1 right, 4:3 wrong, 3:3 and 0:0 a tie), R3908 (3:2 40 s, 4:3 37.5 s, 8:7 and 10:5 20 s), R3904 (no floor field
  carries the truth). Tiers 0-1 "1191 passed, 0 failed, 16 skipped, 1 red (R3339, E48's)". Older tests changed on
  purpose are listed in the commit.

## A season reset gives each passage back (the gaps-65 line, 8ec660aa)

- After a season reset, a player could be sent two copies of the passages with the same stamp - first one with no
  passage, then the one with theirs - and their browser refused the second as not newer, so they kept no passage until
  something else touched their character. Now scripts/passages-gm.mjs `passagesAfterReset` touches each student given
  a passage back, after its cell, so their copy is stamped past the reset's clear. A module race, not the harness's
  timing: a real primary GM whose writes are as slow can do the same.
- Red first: R554's new check, each such student's stamp past the clear (`cleared()`), red at 235c3210 ("[false,false]"),
  green after; R599 adjusted on purpose (its list of cells after the reset leaves out the new `touch/` rows, as its
  list before the reset did).
- Scenario 65-season, 20 runs before and 20 after, in rounds of 4 in parallel on 4 cores
  (docs/dev/gaps/STATUS-GAPS-65.md):
  4 of 20 red at 235c3210, each X4 and X6 together; 0 of 20 at 8ec660aa. Main's CI run 510 was red on the same two
  checks, with p1's copy empty; the race itself was measured locally, with a probe (Checked, CI).
- The changed lines fire none of the gate's detectors; passages-gm.mjs reads `sockets` and `scenes` as a file (read
  with `DETECTORS` for these notes).
